name: Lentils (Red)
siboNotes: Red lentils are high in galactans which can feed SIBO bacteria. Start with very small portions (2 tablespoons) if tolerated, and consider soaking/sprouting to reduce FODMAP content.
preparationTips: Soak dried lentils for 8-12 hours before cooking to reduce galactan content
Cook thoroughly until very soft to improve digestibility
Start with small portions and gradually increase if well tolerated
Rinse canned lentils thoroughly to remove excess oligosaccharides
